season.evidence: Mountaineers reports show early June climbs with snow helping the east col; a SummitPost-style page calls early July best with snow on the route and camps melted out; a general page says Jun-Sep; Peakbagger successful ascents peak in May (18) and Jul-Sep. Stored Jul-Sep widened to include June.

track.why: Our catalog holds exactly one route on Mystery. The recording starts and ends within 50 m of our Upper Dungeness pin, summits within 24 m of the summit, and travels via Royal Basin toward the Deception notch, matching the described line; 41.8 km and about 1,560 m gain agree with that approach. Dated May 22 2026, about a week before the widened window, with no report to confirm the exact line.

otherTracksConsidered.why: Jun 30 2025 north-peak attempt from the glacier side; starts mid-route, not a trailhead round trip.
Starts 15 km from our trailhead, from the Dosewallips side.
Sept 2021 via Del Monte ridge from Sunnybrook Meadows, a different approach.
May 2019 via Del Monte ridge from Home Lake.
Aug 2019 Del Monte ridge combined with Little Mystery.

facts.text: By late June the gully below the summit block can still be full of snow with a moat at the top, forcing a harder, exposed scramble on the rock to its left.

notes: Track 3200931 has no trip report or logged route name; assignment rests on the sole-route rule and the line shape. The May 22 date is early for the stored Jul-Sep window. Several recorded ascents come from the Dosewallips side via Del Monte Ridge and Gunsight Pass; that is a different approach we do not hold as a route.
